name: cde-tau-path
title: What each step of τ changes
idea: At each step of τ the schools' best report states more pairs in all, but a step moves a whole block: it can state pairs whose errors exceed the new price and withhold pairs it stated before.
from: v1 view · v1 S-01 case-cde, the τ-path view; adds the pairs each step states and withholds (relationChange)
